display.name: CreateUpdateDelete statements distribution over endpoints
display.description: All should be redirected to the read-write instance, as it's the only one that can handle these.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
WITH __resource_filter AS (
    SELECT fingerprint 
    FROM signoz_traces.distributed_traces_v3_resource 
    WHERE (simpleJSONExtractString(labels, 'service.name') = 'notification-api')
      AND seen_at_ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp 
)
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts,
    if(attributes_string['net.peer.name'] ILIKE 'read-write-endpoint%', 'Read-Write', 'Read-Only') AS endpoint_type,
    toFloat64(count()) AS value
FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
WHERE 
    resource_fingerprint GLOBAL IN __resource_filter
    AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
    AND timestamp >= $start_datetime 
    AND timestamp <= $end_datetime
    AND (
        name ILIKE 'UPDATE%' 
        OR name ILIKE 'INSERT%' 
        OR name ILIKE 'DELETE%'
    )
    AND (attributes_string['net.peer.name'] ILIKE 'read-write-endpoint.endpoint.proxy%' OR attributes_string['net.peer.name'] ILIKE 'read-only-endpoint.endpoint.proxy%')
GROUP BY ts, endpoint_type
ORDER BY ts ASC

display.name: SELECT statements distribution over endpoints
display.description: This is useful to know if read queries are going to the read-only endpoints. Ideally, these should not go to the read-write instance.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
WITH __resource_filter AS (
    SELECT fingerprint 
    FROM signoz_traces.distributed_traces_v3_resource 
    WHERE (simpleJSONExtractString(labels, 'service.name') = 'notification-api')
      AND seen_at_ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp 
)
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts,
    if(attributes_string['net.peer.name'] ILIKE 'read-write-endpoint%', 'Read-Write', 'Read-Only') AS endpoint_type,
    toFloat64(count()) AS value
FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
WHERE 
    resource_fingerprint GLOBAL IN __resource_filter
    AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
    AND timestamp >= $start_datetime 
    AND timestamp <= $end_datetime
    AND name = 'SELECT NotificationCanadaCaproduction'
    AND (attributes_string['net.peer.name'] ILIKE 'read-write-endpoint.endpoint.proxy%' OR attributes_string['net.peer.name'] ILIKE 'read-only-endpoint.endpoint.proxy%')
GROUP BY ts, endpoint_type
ORDER BY ts ASC
